reviews.review:
Really good game for the price! There's only 3 chapters so far, but the game was engaging and had a nice story. Really good mechanics made it easy to get the hang of.

The main issue I have is that there a quite a few typos, misspelled words and some phrases that are just poorly translated to English. They really need to have a native English speaker review their translations and give feedback.

The other critique is that the acting is pretty awful. A few of the voice actors do a reasonable job, but most of them are hammy and remind me of American dubbed anime...like they're just trying too hard and don't sound natural/believable at all.

Otherwise, it's a lot of fun and I look forward to more chapters being added in the future!

Was recently looking for a good crime/mystery type game and BAM here is this gem. I enjoyed the game play and art style. Although you have to solve puzzles, they cause low stress, and you can redo things if you mess up or don't figure it out. It took me around 5 hours to finish all the chapters and I am really looking forward for more story line with the mains.

I am thoroughly enjoying this game. The gameplay and story are both super interesting, and I quite like that you have the option to continue the investigation after the required information has been collected.

A few criticisms: The dialogue left me wanting a bit, the writing and grammar can be a bit clunky and often characters will use specific uncommon phrases often enough that it becomes noticeable. There were also quite a few spelling and grammatical errors, as well as spoken dialogue not properly matching the subtitles, which can be distracting. 

I also noticed that though dialogue can be skipped sometimes, often in a phone call, if the player has just spoken, the preceding sentence cannot be skipped. I'm aware this is a minor nitpick, but it can be annoying when replaying a certain chapter.

Gameplay wise I have very few criticisms, though I did find that controls in both the inference and telephone passcode sections are not outright broken, but can be quite finicky at times. Also, after a failed attempt at Phishing or Hacking, Ashley has a voiceline where she says she will give you "one more chance". Though this doesn't really make sense within the story of the game, because it is assumed that after you failed in one of these crucial sections and you try again, you're not doing so directly after, but instead you're reverting to a save before you tried the first time. Also a bit of a nitpick, but it still bothered me personally. I don't know if this would be possible to implement, but I think it would be a lot more interesting if the player were reprimanded by Ashley, as usual, but then instead of simply retrying the task again, the player would continue, and have to find a different way to gain the information that they were seeking. 

Overall, I think the idea for this game was amazing, the story is gripping, the gameplay is decent, and the dialogue is lacking. I would definitely reccomend this game, though I do think it's in need of improvements.

Interesting concept, but there's too much hand-holding at the beginning. Inconsistent rules with no explanation = frustrating.

There seems to be only one way to solve the chapters, and the tutorial playthrough is inconsistent with the tutorial's instructions [spoiler](You should be able to use the password to log in to Thomas Conway's Toothbook or the email to his Toothbook, but.. you can't).[/spoiler]
reviews.developer_response: Thank you so much for your feedback. We are keep working on this game and optimizing it.

reviews.review: Holy fuck, that was a good game. For the reviews, I can see it's not everyone's cup of tea; play the demo and if you like it BUY IT, it's fucking addictive. To be fair, its not perfect: the voice acting is shitty sometimes, there are some bugs (you might need to restart the game), a few typos (one of them was kinda criminal, not gonna lie) and it gets REALLY hard sometimes (but people in Steam can help you if you get stuck). If you don't mind that, probably would like it as much as I did. I'm so looking forward to the next chapters to be completed.

I bought this game the second I saw it because I am a huge fan of games like Orwell, Do Not Feed the Monkeys, and Need to Know. This game is great for players who enjoy those. I found the game to be quite good at leading you where you need to go without being too in your face with clues. Now I will say that it does not have the same "choices matter" story, and there are noticeable grammar and spelling errors, but overall I think it is worth checking out. It is a good experience for this sort of "genre" of game that is heavily based on connecting clues. I would give it a 7/10
Phenomenal game. A few typos and the voice acting could have a bit more emotion to it but overall a really enjoyable game and I can't wait for the next chapter!

I highly recommend this game, the story so far is great, the gameplay is spot on, the attention to detail is also great. This game is so good is so many places but it does fall short in a few other places such as some of the incorrect spelling of words or the mispronunciation of words, the dialogue also falls short abit but with a game like this, but I feel in my opinion that gameplay is a more important aspect. If you can look past just a few small spelling and grammar errors, than this game is amazing and i can't wait to see what else they will bring and how they will continue the story.
I had not realized that this was an early access game!! The first three chapters were very appealing and drew me in each time, as I tried to uncover each secret. I look forward to the complete game!!

Pros:
 - interesting detective stories. They are not sophisticated or complicated they just decent ones. Sometime a new clue opens another side of one of the suspect. 
- puzzles.   They are not difficult and probably you would never stuck on them. 
-  "hacking" process is simplified and fast. You can intrude to the phone, email or social network profile of suspect to gather evidence.
 

Pros:
 - no localization :) 

Gameplay is very simple - read tonnes of text and find clues.  Sometimes you would have an option to solve a puzzle.  I recommend the game for people who want to play detective role.
The game itself has good stories and plot twists, but there are some text boxes that aren't shown properly. But i think the pros overcome the cons......so yea, quite enjoyable

I highly recommend this game to anyone who once enjoyed the Nancy Drew Detective PC games or if they're a fan of puzzles and critical thinking. This game has a very well constructed story that is slowly revealed as you collect information. I truly find this game is like the Nancy Drew Series but is far more challenging and more up to date; as in the player being a computer hacker for a business corporation, instead of a 1950's teenage detective.And the game also informs players to be aware of how easy it can be for hackers to collect information. 

Overall this game is 10 out of 10. Can't wait for more chapters to be added.
Great fun game for who loves clues and investigating games

I appreciate this game is in early access. Some people say there are some bugs but I've not seen any myself. I love the concept of the game and it's a nice game to just play and chill.

The two negative things about the game for me personally are the following:
Voice acting isn't great. Sorry, but it's just very emotionless.
This one is minor but still: You have to click to continue a conversation. It would be nice if there was a timer to roll on unless you have an option to choose. 

Other than that, if you like this kind of game and don't mind early access then it's worth a try, especially for £5 (when on sale).

First time I've played a game like this and got to say I'm loving it, you're not rushed into anything you can take it at your own pace, though I'm stuck at the moment on chapter 2, hacking Van's server I can't find the second clue so any help would be appreciated so i can move on, looking forward to seeing the additional content
Really enjoyable puzzelgame. Moderate difficulty with a fun setting.

Great game so far, though there are lots of grammatical errors and spelling mistakes. Sometimes clues are hard to understand and acting is pretty bad (on the phone for example). Lots of game-breaking bugs. For example when I finished the demo I had to start my save all over again because there is no autosave function. Once I had to play the second level all over again because the game didn't record Jon's encrypted email password. However, considering the games came out 4 days ago, pretty good stuff. Can't wait to see what the developers think of next.

The concept and execution are done quite well. I love the mechanics of the game also. However it is still in Early Access so there are bugs and things that aren't finalized. There are also a lot of grammar issues in the dialogue as well as just the game text, if you can look passed that it's pretty good. I don't see a lot of games like this so I find it rather unique. 

Also, the demo is pretty sizable, the only downside is your save data doesn't transfer to the full game once you buy it so you have to redo all of that, which frustrated me quite a bit.

Fun game, A lot of typos and errors in the English version. Makes hard to get emotion across when characters have email conversations. I like that the game has a themes of real social behavior. Its realistic. I'd like more flexibility with search engine and gathering information. I'd appreciate it if it becomes more of a sandboxy experience rather then a linear one. 
I'm stuck on chapter 2  Finding 2 clues in the "underground extortioning" section. I can't find the advertisement photo or see Elsie's hidden photo. I don't have access to the characters emails so I cant hack emails. Is this a bug?
   
   Despite the bugs the game is very addicting and satisfying. Looking forward to seeing the finished version. I recommend this game.
Super nice game, I liked it very much! Too bad there's only 3 Chapters, I'm waiting for more!

This game is a masterpiece. Let me say that even when I took advantage of the sale to save more money, I still felt like I paid too little for such a great game.
The amount of detail is superb. Not only does the game feel good to play, but exploration in the game is so much fun. This is pretty much the gold standard for Chinese games if there are interesting pieces of evidence throughout and choices that go onto influence other missions and even endings.
Overall, just buy this game.
The game is can be a difficult puzzle at times, but it is very fun if your into the tech and hacking scene. I high recommend and I can't wait for more chapters!
An Incredible experience! Although I am unsure as how to get the Don't Want To Work achievement, but the story and the mechanics are incredible. 10/10 Would Play again.

I really want to like this game. It's a really solid crime solving game, and this concept could really be something special with a little bit more polish and love put into it.
Really the only thing that broke the immersion of being a crime fighting hackermans were the grammatical errors in a large portion of the dialogue (admittedly some of which made me crack up) and some of the conversation choices were bit vague in how to go about solving. Neither of these things would be considered a real problem, everything was smooth sailing...until I got to the 2nd chapter where the game seemingly just dies/crashes every time I try to hack [spoiler]Van's server[/spoiler]. I've tried multiple times, tried different workarounds, same result, I cannot progress my game due to this bug.
Obviously the game is early access, and I'm willing to change the rating when the final product releases, but the fact that it's unplayable for me now I cannot give a positive recommendation.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you so much for your feedback. My team is working on the bugs and grammatical errors already. I will update a new version soon which will fix most of major bugs, and some of grammatical errors. But I know I should keep optimizing grammatical issue. 
Thank you again for playing my game

reviews.review:
Amazing puzzler game akin to phoenix wright as a hacker. the stories are engaging and morally interesting and the puzzles themselves are based around investigating and reading through the history and lore of individuals and past events.
There are some translation errors, especially in the latter half of the game, but they don't take anything away from the game as a whole.

Intriguing game and one of the better experiences I've had this year, and easily worth the price.

EDIT: After its full release and my consequent replay of the full game I have to say this game is amazing for the price. i had such a blast playing through this i cant recommend it enough.

BE WARNED THOUGH. There are very adult themes in this game and they can be considered very upsetting to audiences.
Good

Really enjoyed the game and the puzzles that came with it. The cases were also enjoyable and fun to break down. I will say though that the fail screens could be sped up a little, I felt every time I did mess up I had to wait like a minute each time, which doesn't sound like a lot but I goofed a couple times and he broke the pacing for me. Besides that, the game was pretty solid and I would recommend it if you are looking for a puzzle game to get the brain a working.

Like the game's description reads, this game is similar to Orwell. Seeing that, I figured I'll buy it and try it out and have enjoyed it so far. The writing is good, albeit full of grammar errors especially past case 1, the pace at which I found new information was enjoyable. My only problem is with the actual plot, and the complete lack of preparation the game and store page gave me. While there's no nudity, this game needs a massive content warning for sexual violence. I sincerely wish I had preparation for it as I just feel too uncomfortable to continue.

Until the game or its store page has a content warning, I don't feel comfortable recommending it.
reviews.developer_response: Hi, thank you for liking this game. Also I am sorry to make you uncomfortable. I will contact with Steam and to see if we need content warning on store page. Thank you again!

reviews.review: very fun game with good story. looking forward for the next story :)

Like the devs and other players have mentioned this game has some pretty real and some pretty not quite real aspects to it. I have a bit of experience in the cyber security industry and one of my lecturers recommended me this game. I believe the devs have done their fair dues when researching for this game and it shows with some pretty real scenarios and some real and not as real techniques (or not in public knowledge).

Now down to the actual gameplay. Cyber Manhunt is a puzzle/deduction game that puts you into the shoes of a freelance "hacker" contracted by the company "Titan" whom gives you jobs and investigations to solve.
Some of these investigations truly made me engaged and wanting to find out more. It scratches that "nosey" itch in my head.

It can definitely be frustrating trying to find the last clue to one of the targets, you can have already pieced the story together but you're missing a clue from a "facebook" page (it's called "toothbook" in the game) that doesn't have that much to do with what you are investigating. Also the translation could also use some work but I understand that it's probably a small dev team and they obviously do not speak english as their main language the typos didn't effect the puzzles for me atleast. These things however will be easy to fix though.

Cyber Manhunt is an enjoyable puzzle game that is definitely worth the price they are asking especially if you get it while it's on sale at the moment. There are some bugs here and there but they are pretty minor and the devs have made it clear that they are working on them and intend to listen to the player base on issues we have.

Overall, it's very awesome and satisfying. However, if I may, the sound in this game sounded very generic and computer-generated. If (a big if) possible, you know, like, make it sounded more realistic and human sounded. Anyway, off I go searching for the last optional mission clue!

Unfortunately, the English translation needs a lot of work before it's ready to go live, and while it's easy enough to look past this in other games, this genre requires pretty much perfect translations. 

Maybe one day I'll come back to it, but the mistranslations are really unfortunate.

reviews.review: original
good game

I was drawn in by the demo and decided to purchase Early Access.

If you don't run into any hiccups with the puzzles, the game should take you about 3-4 hours to complete.

The story is pretty good, and the method of storytelling through puzzles is akin to that of Orwell, and Papers, Please. The methods used to collect information are a combination of real-life techniques (and maybe one that's not too far off from actual realisation). The developers themselves stated that they did some research into it. For what the game's intended message is supposed to be, it's well done.

Of course, being in Early Access, it's not entirely perfect, but the developers have created a bug thread on the Discussions page, so please give your input there if possible.

The only real gripe I have with the game is the wonky English, but it doesn't affect any understanding of the story. It may however, affect how you figure out puzzle solutions, but that wasn't the case with me.
